grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, eggs, milk, butter, honey, vanilla, fresh rhubarb, strawberries and Greek yoghurt are all plain home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket in May.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a bowl and a whisk, and the technique is simple mixing and baking.

works.reason: 200g oats to 400ml milk and 2 eggs at 190°C for 30 to 35 minutes sets well for four, and the honey, strawberries and yoghurt balance the tart rhubarb.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers whisking, cutting the rhubarb and slicing the strawberries, and the 35-minute bake is unattended and matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Early May rhubarb is the point of a warm baked breakfast, which suits a cool spring morning.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, eggs, milk, fruit and yoghurt make a filling breakfast with only modest added honey.
